title: Read-only Compute Broker: RunPod GPU inventory feeds no-spend quotes; throughput is an explicit input
summary: compute.py adds a provider-neutral inventory interface (normalized offers: provider, gpu_id, name, vram_gb, tier, usd_per_hour) with RunPod as the first source (public GraphQL gpuTypes; secure/community tiers; price 0 or tier flag false = not offered). A key is sent only when secrets://runpod/default is configured; results are cached 6 h under the orchestrator home; network/GraphQL failures return an empty inventory with the error instead of raising. gpu_options turns the cheapest offers meeting the workload VRAM floor into quote.py gpu_pod options. Throughput (generation or training tokens/s) must be supplied: the broker never invents it, and without it no GPU option is priced. `orchestrate compute inventory` and `orchestrate quote --gpu-from runpod --gen-tps/--train-tps` expose it. EVR-0017 is the first live no-spend API-vs-RunPod quote (acceptance 3, with assumed throughput and API price). No provisioning code exists; lifecycle (provision/stop/destroy/auto-stop/reconcile) is the next gated slice, to be designed after the SkyPilot spike (PA-skypilot).
